title: Real form of the counterexample
statement: For every point $x$ of the two-dimensional sign cube, the real-valued form of the negative OR function equals $\bigl(1- x_0-x_1-x_0x_1\bigr)/2$, where $x_0$ and $x_1$ are the coordinate signs of $x$.
